title: Unfair or deceptive acts or practices.
bodyText: Any person who violates this chapter shall be deemed to have engaged in an unfair or deceptive act or practice within the meaning of section 480-2.
bodyHtml: [§481M-9]  Unfair or deceptive acts or practices.  Any person who violates this chapter shall be deemed to have engaged in an unfair or deceptive act or practice within the meaning of section 480-2. [L 1997, c 248, pt of §1]
